accepted.evidence: Buddruss p26 item16 explicitly derives ac from *az from *aj, comparing the same z > c change elsewhere in Grangali. Turner242 adya gives regional aj/az today through MIA ajja. This source-explicit consonant development supports the existing today family without normalizing the installed affricate.
Turner7576 explicitly lists Shumashti nun today under nūnam now, alongside Pashai nū and Gawri nūn. Buddruss p26 item16 confirms Shumashti nun as a distinct comparison, not a variant of Grangali ac.

Buddruss p31 item97 gives Grangali byeλ, with another collection’s bel, beside Shumashti wyel and Gawri yel. Turner11625 vikāla evening gives Pashai vyāl/vel, Gawri yel and regional byäl forms. The b-y-l family and night sense support this assignment. The source lambda transcription is retained; unlike Shumashti, no specific loan route is established for this Grangali record.

Turner11625 explicitly marks Pashai Kurangali vel as the donor of Shumashti wyel. Existing donor f_hv6ravplmmn4m has canonical Pas, dialect Kurangali and verified rank1 ancestry11625. Buddruss p31 item97 independently gives Shumashti wyel. Use this immediate donor rather than a direct reflex to vikāla.
